# Tasks: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/005-multi-source-timeline/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md (all present)

**Tests**: Included. RNF07 (`lib/**/domain/**` ≥80% coverage) is carried into this unit's Constitution
Check as "PASS (gate carried into tasks)", and both `contracts/entries-repository-extension.md` and
`contracts/records-bloc.md` each define an explicit scenario table "for `/speckit-tasks` to
schedule" — so test tasks are generated alongside implementation, matching RF01/RF02/RF03's existing
`bloc_test`/`mocktail` style exactly.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1–US4, spec.md priorities P1/P1/P2/P3). Per
contracts/records-bloc.md, `RecordsBloc` and `RecordsPage` are each extended incrementally across
several stories (same convention RF02's own tasks.md used for the shared `InsertionModalBloc`) — "independent" here means each story's acceptance scenarios can be exercised and automated-tested on
their own once the prior stories it builds on exist, not that each story gets its own bloc or page.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependency on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1 (seeing every entry, regardless of origin), US2 (starting from nothing /
  empty state), US3 (session expires while browsing), US4 (the sync badge tells the truth during
  session trouble)

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter project (F000/RF01/RF03's existing `lib/`, `test/`) — see plan.md Project Structure.
This unit fills in the already-existing `lib/features/records/` placeholder feature folder and
extends `lib/features/entries/`, `lib/core/network/`, `lib/core/di/`, `lib/core/routing/`, and
`lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/` in place; no new top-level directory.

---

## Phase 1: Setup

**Purpose**: Project initialization — N/A for this unit.

No setup tasks apply. This unit adds no new package, no native-project change, and no new `.env`
variable — it reuses the full existing stack as-is (plan.md Technical Context, Primary
Dependencies: "No additions"; research.md R9 explicitly rejects adding `intl`). Proceed directly to
Foundational.

---

## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)

**Purpose**: The `entries/` extensions every story's data ultimately flows through
(`ApiClient.queryParameters`, `EntrySource.chat`, `EntriesPage`, `EntriesRepository.list()`/
`.getById()` with silent-refresh-and-retry), plus the three pure `records/domain/` helpers
(`SyncBadge`, `DateGrouper`, `EntryMerger`) every story's presentation layer calls. No UI exists yet
after this phase — `RecordsBloc`/`RecordsPage` are built starting in User Story 1.

**⚠️ CRITICAL**: No user story work can begin until this phase is complete.

- [ ] T001 [P] Add a `Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters` parameter to `ApiClient.call()` in `lib/core/network/api_client.dart`, passed straight through to `Dio.request()`'s own `queryParameters` argument (research.md R1); every existing call site (`entries-create`, `auth-session`, `auth-refresh`, `media-ocr`) omits it and is byte-for-byte unaffected (contracts/entries-repository-extension.md)
- [ ] T002 [P] Change `enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }` to `enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }` in `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`, replacing the stale doc comment ("`chat` is RF10's own addition — this unit creates only these three") with one explaining that `chat` exists so a `GET /entries`-returned chat-origin entry parses and renders instead of throwing `ArgumentError` out of `EntrySource.values.byName(...)` (research.md R2, spec.md Edge Cases)
- [ ] T003 [P] Create `EntriesPage` in `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entries_page.dart`: an `Equatable` class with `final List<Entry> entries` (the order the backend returns, newest-occurred-first) and `final String? nextCursor` (`null` means the last page) — the shape of one `GET /entries` response minus `meta.total` and the `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` filter params reserved for RF06 (data-model.md)
- [ ] T004 Extend the `EntriesRepository` abstract class in `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` with `Future<Either<Failure, EntriesPage>> list({String? cursor})` and `Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> getById(String id)`; `create()`/`cachedEntries` stay unchanged (contracts/entries-repository-extension.md) — depends on T002, T003
- [ ] T005 Extend `EntriesRemoteDataSource` in `lib/features/entries/data/entries_remote_data_source.dart`: keep the existing private `_parseEntry(Map<String, dynamic>)` (used by `create()`) reusable as-is for a single object; add `Future<Either<Failure, EntriesPage>> list({String? cursor})` calling `_apiClient.call('entries-list', method: 'GET', queryParameters: cursor == null ? null : {'cursor': cursor})` and parsing the result through a new private `_parseEntriesPage` (each element of `data` through `_parseEntry`, plus `meta.nextCursor`, with no duplicated per-entry parsing logic); add `Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> getById(String id)` calling `_apiClient.call('entries-get', method: 'GET', pathSegments: [id]).flatMap(_parseEntry)`; malformed-response `TypeError`/`FormatException` map to `ValidationFailure` for both new methods, exactly like `create()`'s existing catch clauses (contracts/entries-repository-extension.md) — depends on T001, T002, T004
- [ ] T006 Extend `EntriesRepositoryImpl` in `lib/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl.dart`: add a `SessionRepository` constructor dependency (`session/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart` — a cross-feature *domain*-interface dependency, the same shape `SessionRepositoryImpl` already has on `auth`'s `Account`, research.md R4); add a private `Future<Either<Failure, T>> _retryAfterSilentRefresh<T>(Future<Either<Failure, T>> Function() retry)` helper that calls `_sessionRepository.refresh()` and, on `Left`, returns `Left(const AuthExpiredFailure(message: 'Session could not be renewed', requestId: ''))` (a fresh instance regardless of the refresh attempt's own failure shape), or on `Right`, calls `retry()` exactly once (no loop, no second refresh attempt); implement `list({String? cursor})`/`getById(String id)` as: call the matching remote-data-source method once, and when it comes back `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)` route through `_retryAfterSilentRefresh`, otherwise return the `Left`/`Right` unchanged; `create()`/`cachedEntries` are untouched (contracts/entries-repository-extension.md) — depends on T004, T005
- [ ] T007 Update `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`'s `EntriesRepositoryImpl` registration to inject `sessionRepository: getIt<SessionRepository>()` (already registered earlier in the file for `SessionBloc`) — depends on T006
- [ ] T008 [P] Extend `test/features/entries/data/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` with `list()`/`getById()` coverage per contracts/entries-repository-extension.md's scenario table: `list(cursor: 'abc')` sends `queryParameters: {'cursor': 'abc'}` to `ApiClient.call`; `list()` with no cursor sends `queryParameters: null`; a response containing a `chat`-sourced entry parses to `EntrySource.chat` without throwing (research.md R2); a malformed response for either new method maps to `ValidationFailure` — depends on T005
- [ ] T009 [P] Extend `test/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl_test.dart` with `list()`/`getById()` coverage per contracts/entries-repository-extension.md's scenario table, against a `mocktail` fake `SessionRepository` and fake `EntriesRemoteDataSource`: success on the first attempt returns `Right` with no refresh call made; `AuthExpiredFailure` followed by a successful refresh retries and returns `Right`, with exactly 2 remote calls and 1 refresh call; `AuthExpiredFailure` followed by a refresh that itself fails returns `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)` with no second refresh attempt; any other failure code (timeout/offline/validation/...) passes through as `Left(<that failure>)` unchanged with no refresh attempted — depends on T006
- [ ] T010 [P] Extend `test/core/network/api_client_test.dart` confirming `call()`'s new `queryParameters` argument reaches the underlying `Dio.request()` call verbatim when provided, and is omitted (`null`) when not provided — depends on T001
- [ ] T011 [P] Create `SyncBadgeState`/`LocalWriteOutcome` enums and the pure, total `SyncBadge.derive(LocalWriteOutcome? localWrite)` static method in `lib/features/records/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart` (data-model.md): `null` → `SyncBadgeState.synchronized`, `LocalWriteOutcome.pending` → `synchronizing`, `LocalWriteOutcome.failed` → `error` — the function takes no session/auth-related input at all, trivially satisfying FR-005's independence requirement (research.md R6)
- [ ] T012 [P] Create `test/features/records/domain/entities/sync_badge_state_test.dart` covering `SyncBadge.derive`'s 3 branches (`null`/`pending`/`failed` → `synchronized`/`synchronizing`/`error`) — depends on T011
- [ ] T013 [P] Create `DateGroup`/`DateGrouper` in `lib/features/records/domain/entities/date_group.dart` (data-model.md): `DateGroup` is an `Equatable` with `final String label` and `final List<Entry> entries`; `DateGrouper.group(List<Entry> entries, {DateTime? now})` buckets entries by comparing each one's `occurredAt.toLocal()` calendar day against `(now ?? DateTime.now()).toLocal()`'s — "Hoje" for today, "Ontem" for yesterday, else `'{day} de {monthName}'` built from a 12-entry `const` Portuguese month-name list local to the file (research.md R9 — no `intl` dependency, no year shown); the input is assumed already sorted newest-to-oldest and `group()` only buckets, never re-sorts within or across groups
- [ ] T014 [P] Create `test/features/records/domain/entities/date_group_test.dart` covering: entries occurring today/yesterday/an older explicit date bucket under "Hoje"/"Ontem"/`'{day} de {monthName}'` respectively, using the deterministic `now` override for repeatability; groups come out in the input's own newest-to-oldest order, with no re-sorting introduced within or across groups — depends on T013
- [ ] T015 [P] Create `EntryMerger` in `lib/features/records/domain/entities/entry_merger.dart` (data-model.md, spec.md's resolved Clarification 3): `EntryMerger.merge({required List<Entry> primary, required List<Entry> secondary})` unions the two lists by `id`; on a shared id, `primary`'s copy wins (the Clarification's "prefer the freshly-fetched copy's `updatedAt`/`serverRevision`" is satisfied by always calling `merge` with the fresher data as `primary`); the result is sorted newest-to-oldest by `occurredAt` regardless of the two input lists' own order
- [ ] T016 [P] Create `test/features/records/domain/entities/entry_merger_test.dart` covering: an entry present in only one of the two lists passes through unchanged; an id present in both lists is shown exactly once, using `primary`'s copy of that entry's fields (SC-001's "100% of entries appear exactly once"); the merged result is sorted newest-to-oldest by `occurredAt` even when the two inputs are supplied in a different or mixed order — depends on T015

**Checkpoint**: `EntriesRepository.list()`/`.getById()` work end to end with silent-refresh-and-retry
on `AuthExpiredFailure`, and `records/domain/`'s three pure helpers (`SyncBadge`, `DateGrouper`,
`EntryMerger`) all exist and are unit-tested. No UI exists yet — user story work can now begin.

---

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Seeing every entry in one place, regardless of origin (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Opening "Meus Registros" fetches and displays all of the signed-in user's entries —
manual, audio, photo, and chat — in one reverse-chronological, date-grouped list, each card carrying
an origin marker, a time, a text excerpt, tag chips (when present), and a synchronization badge;
scrolling to the bottom loads and appends further pages automatically without disturbing what's
already on screen.

**Independent Test**: Seed a user with entries of different origins across different days, open
"Meus Registros", and confirm every entry appears exactly once, grouped under the correct date
heading, with an origin-appropriate visual marker on each; scroll to exercise pagination.

- [ ] T018 [P] [US1] Create the `RecordsState` sealed class with `RecordsLoading`, `RecordsLoadFailure(Failure failure)`, and `RecordsLoaded(entries, nextCursor, isLoadingMore, pageLoadFailure)` — including the `hasReachedEnd` (`nextCursor == null`) and `isEmpty` (`entries.isEmpty`) getters (data-model.md) in `lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_state.dart`

RecordsLoaded || current.hasReachedEnd || current.isLoadingMore`; otherwise emits an `isLoadingMore: true` snapshot, calls `list(cursor: current.nextCursor)`, and on `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)` leaves `entries`/`nextCursor` exactly as they were with `isLoadingMore` reset to `false` and `pageLoadFailure` left `null` (FR-007's "restored exactly as it was" holds by construction) while still firing `reauthRequired`; on any other `Left`, sets `pageLoadFailure` to that failure with `entries`/`nextCursor` unchanged and `isLoadingMore` reset to `false` (FR-009); on `Right`, emits the merged (`EntryMerger.merge(primary: current.entries + page.entries, secondary: cachedEntries)`), appended entry list with the new `nextCursor`. ## Phase 4: User Story 2 - Starting from nothing (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: A zero-entries account sees a clear empty state (notebook illustration, "Nenhum registro
ainda", "Criar primeiro registro") instead of a blank list; completing a save from that action

## Phase 5: User Story 3 - The session expires while browsing (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: A session expiring while the user is scrolled partway through their history surfaces the
existing "Sessão expirada" overlay without discarding the loaded entries or the scroll position;
re-authenticating dismisses the overlay and restores the screen exactly as it was.

**Independent Test**: Load the timeline, scroll to a known position, force a session-expired
response, confirm the overlay appears without resetting the list, and confirm re-authentication
restores that exact scroll position and content.

## Phase 6: User Story 4 - The synchronization badge tells the truth, even during session trouble (Priority: P3)

**Goal**: Every entry's synchronization badge keeps showing an accurate, unchanged state throughout
a silent session renewal or a "Sessão expirada" overlay cycle — never frozen, blanked, or delayed by
session/authentication handling.

**Independent Test**: Put entries in each of the three badge states, force a session expiration and
renewal in the background, and confirm every badge's state is unaffected by that session activity
throughout.

### Implementation for User Story 4

- [ ] T036 [P] [US4] Extend `test/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_bloc_test.dart` with a scenario proving entry data relevant to the sync badge is unaffected by session trouble: capture the `entries` list (and each entry's `SyncBadge.derive(localWrite: null)` result) from a `RecordsLoaded` state, trigger a `NextPageRequested` that fails `AuthExpiredFailure`, and assert both the entry list and every entry's derived badge state are byte-identical afterward (data-model.md R6; spec.md User Story 4 Acceptance Scenario 1) — depends on T035 (US3)

Registros" screen now matches spec.md end to end.

## Phase 7: Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns

**Purpose**: The constitution/quickstart gates that span every story above.

- [ ] T038 [P] Run `fvm flutter analyze` and resolve any lint findings introduced under `lib/features/records/`, `lib/features/entries/`, `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/open_insertion_modal.dart`, `lib/core/network/api_client.dart`, `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`, and `lib/core/routing/app_router.dart` by this unit
- [ ] T039 [P] Run `test/architecture/domain_purity_test.dart` and confirm it still reports 0 violations with `entries_page.dart`, `sync_badge_state.dart`, `date_group.dart`, and `entry_merger.dart` included — none of them may import `package:flutter` or any `data/` class (RNF06, Post-Design Constitution Check)
- [ ] T040 Run `fvm flutter test --coverage`, extract `lib/**/domain/**` via `lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info`, and confirm ≥80% coverage (RNF07) with `entry_merger.dart`/`date_group.dart`/`sync_badge_state.dart` and `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s new `list()`/`getById()` silent-refresh-and-retry branches all covered
- [ ] T041 Execute quickstart.md's remaining manual verification on the iOS Simulator: Story 1's full scroll-to-end pagination and the seeded `chat`-origin entry's rendering; Story 2's empty-state-to-populated transition; Story 3's forced-expiry-and-overlay-and-restore cycle; and the Edge Cases section (airplane-mode mid-scroll retryable error with no write attempted; a forced first-load outright failure that never shows the empty state; the inert header download icon and search bar/funnel button rendering per the prototype but doing nothing; a seeded account whose newest page is empty while older entries exist continuing to page into those older groups rather than showing the empty state)

---

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No tasks — proceed directly to Foundational.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: No dependencies — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–6)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) builds the core `RecordsBloc`/`RecordsPage`/widgets and is this unit's MVP.
  - US2 (P1) extends `RecordsBloc` (`_onLocalCacheRefreshed`) and `RecordsPage` (the empty-state
    branch) built in US1 — depends on US1's T019/T023 already existing.
  - US3 (P2) extends `RecordsPage` (the `reauthRequired` subscription) built in US1/US2 — depends on
    US1's T023 and US2's T031 (same file) already existing. `RecordsBloc`'s own `AuthExpiredFailure`
    branching was already built correctly in US1's T019; US3 adds the widget-level wiring plus the
    tests that specifically exercise it.
  - US4 (P3) depends on US3's `AuthExpiredFailure` test fixtures (T035) to build its own
    badge-independence assertion against, and on US3's overlay wiring (T033) for its manual
    verification step.
- **Polish (Phase 7)**: Depends on all four stories being complete.

### Within Each User Story

- Events/state additions before the bloc handler that needs them; the bloc handler before the DI
  registration that constructs it; DI before the page that reads it via `context.read<RecordsBloc>()`.
- Tests are written alongside (and can run immediately after) each handler task, extending one
  shared `records_bloc_test.dart` across stories — the same convention RF02's own tasks.md used for
  `insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart`.
- Story complete (events/state + bloc handlers + widgets + DI/routing + tests) before moving to the
  next priority.

### Parallel Opportunities

- T001, T002, T003 (Foundational `entries/` plumbing) in parallel with each other; T011, T013, T015
  (Foundational `records/domain/` helpers) in parallel with each other and with T001–T003 — all
  different files.
- T008, T009, T010 (Foundational test extensions) in parallel with each other once their respective
  implementation tasks land.
- T012, T014, T016 (pure-helper tests) in parallel with each other once T011/T013/T015 land.
- T017/T018 (US1 event/state files) in parallel with each other; T021/T022 (US1 widgets) in parallel
  with each other once T011 (Foundational) lands.
- T038/T039 (Polish) in parallel with each other.

---

## Parallel Example: Foundational Phase

```bash
Task: "Add queryParameters to ApiClient.call() in lib/core/network/api_client.dart"
Task: "Add EntrySource.chat to lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart"
Task: "Create EntriesPage in lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entries_page.dart"
Task: "Create SyncBadge in lib/features/records/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart"
Task: "Create DateGrouper in lib/features/records/domain/entities/date_group.dart"
Task: "Create EntryMerger in lib/features/records/domain/entities/entry_merger.dart"
```

## Parallel Example: User Story 1 bloc scaffolding

```bash
Task: "Create RecordsEvent in lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_event.dart"
Task: "Create RecordsState in lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_state.dart"
```

---

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
2. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
3. **STOP and VALIDATE**: open "Meus Registros" on a seeded account, confirm every entry appears
   exactly once grouped by date with the right origin marker/badge/excerpt/tags, and confirm
   scrolling to the bottom loads and appends further pages without disturbing what's on screen.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Foundational → `EntriesRepository.list()`/`.getById()` and the three pure `records/domain/`
   helpers exist; nothing visible changes yet.
2. Add US1 → "Meus Registros" works end to end for an account with entries (SC-001, SC-003).
3. Add US2 → a zero-entries account sees the empty state and can create its first entry from it
   (SC-002).
4. Add US3 → a session expiring mid-browse surfaces the overlay without data loss (SC-004).
5. Add US4 → the sync badge's session-independence property is explicitly verified (SC-005).
6. Polish → RNF06/RNF07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.

---

## Notes

- `records_bloc.dart` and `records_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases
  (T019/T020/T030 for the bloc; T023/T031/T033 for the page) — this mirrors RF02's own tasks.md
  precedent: a deliberate consequence of one shared bloc/page serving the whole screen, not a
  same-file conflict to avoid.
- `records_placeholder_page.dart` is deleted only in T026 (US1), once `AppRoutes.records` no longer
  references it (T024) — the app must keep compiling at every checkpoint.
- No task in this list touches `docs/input/`, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, any
  native iOS project file, or any RF04–RF10/extension-feature behavior — all explicitly out of scope
  (FR-010, FR-011).
- `EntriesRepository.getById()` is implemented and tested (T005, T006, T008, T009) but has no call
  site anywhere in this task list, by design (research.md R7) — nothing in this unit ever produces a
  locally-pending/unreconciled entry for it to reconcile.
- Every color `record_card.dart`/`sync_badge_dot.dart` render (T021, T022) already exists in
  `DesignTokens` — no task in this list adds a new design token (plan.md Constraints, Principle
  IV/RNF08).

2	
3	**Branch**: `005-multi-source-timeline` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec.md header)
4	
5	**Date**: 2026-10-17 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
6	
7	**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/005-multi-source-timeline/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md`
8	§1 (RF07), §6.1/§6.2 (`/auth/session`, `/auth/refresh`, `/entries`, `/entries/:id`), §8 (data model), §9, §13;
9	`docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`; `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/entries/{id}`

11	Depends on F000 (`specs/001-foundation/`) and RF01 (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/`), both already
12	implemented — this is the first unit to make the already-built `SessionBloc`/overlay machinery and
13	`EntriesRepository`/`cachedEntries` seam actually earn their keep from outside `session/`/`capture/`.
14	
15	## Summary
16	
17	"Meus Registros" fetches and displays every one of the signed-in user's journal entries — manual, audio,
18	photo, and (origin-agnostically) chat — in one reverse-chronological, date-grouped, infinitely-scrolling
19	timeline, each card carrying a per-entry synchronization badge computed purely on-device. It reuses RF01's
20	`Entry`/`EntriesRepository`/`CreateEntryUseCase` (extended with two new read methods and a fourth
21	`EntrySource` value, never replaced) and F000's `SessionBloc`/"Sessão expirada" overlay (extended with its
22	first real caller, never modified) rather than building either from scratch. The screen's own new code is a
23	single `RecordsBloc` (depending only on `EntriesRepository`) plus a small amount of pure domain logic
24	(date-grouping, local-cache/fetched-page merge-by-ID, sync-badge derivation) — the one piece of genuine new
25	architecture this unit introduces is *how* a session expiring mid-browse reaches the existing, unmodified
26	overlay without one BLoC ever importing another (research.md R4/R5): the silent refresh-and-retry lives
27	inside `EntriesRepositoryImpl` (reusable by any future authenticated entries read), and the final "I could not
28	renew, please show the overlay" signal crosses from `RecordsBloc` to the app-wide `SessionBloc` through a
29	one-shot stream consumed by the page widget — never by one bloc holding a reference to the other.
30	
31	## Technical Context
32	
33	**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
34	F000/RF03/RF01/RF02.
35	
36	**Primary Dependencies**: No additions (research.md R9 explicitly rejects adding `intl`). Reuses the full
37	existing stack — `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `get_it`, `equatable`, `dio` (via `ApiClient`, extended with
38	`queryParameters` support — research.md R1), `go_router`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`.
39

inside `EntriesRepositoryImpl` (reusable by any future authenticated entries read), and the final "I could not
renew, please show the overlay" signal crosses from `RecordsBloc` to the app-wide `SessionBloc` through a


**Structure Decision**: Fills in the existing `records/` placeholder feature (research.md R8) rather than
introducing a new `timeline/` feature; extends `entries/` and `core/network`/`core/di` in place; makes one
small, genuinely new cross-feature wire (the `reauthRequired` one-shot stream into the page, research.md R5)
rather than touching `session/`'s already-built, already-correct machinery at all.

## Complexity Tracking

*No entries — this unit adds no new dependency and no new feature folder (reuses `records/`); its one
cross-cutting concern (reaching the existing session-expired overlay without bloc-to-bloc coupling) is solved
with a one-shot stream pattern already proven in this codebase (`InsertionModalBloc.closeRequests`), not a
new kind of architectural seam.*

## Post-Design Constitution Check

Re-evaluated after Phase 1 (data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md):

- `RecordsBloc` and every `records/domain/` file were re-checked against their actual planned imports:
  `fpdart`, `equatable`, `core/network/failure.dart`, `entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`,
  `entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` — no `package:flutter`, no `data/` class, no other
  feature's `presentation/bloc/` path. RNF06/Principle V confirmed before any code exists.
- `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s new `SessionRepository` dependency was re-checked against RNF06: it is a
  `data/`-to-`domain/` cross-feature dependency (the same shape `SessionRepositoryImpl` → `auth`'s `Account`
  already has), never a `data/`-to-`data/` or `data/`-to-`presentation/` one — no violation.
- The one place `SessionBloc` is imported outside `session/` (`records_page.dart`) was re-checked against
  requirements.md RF07's literal wording ("No BLoC imports another BLoC directly") — `RecordsPage` is a
  `State<StatefulWidget>`, not a `Bloc` subclass, so this holds literally, not just in spirit. This mirrors
  `main.dart`'s and `session_expired_overlay.dart`'s own existing, already-shipped pattern of a *widget*
  (never a bloc) being the thing that reads one feature's bloc stream and dispatches into another's.
- Re-checked R7's "no call site for `getById()`" conclusion against `requirements.md` §9 ("Entries are
  immutable: there is no `PATCH /entries/:id` or `DELETE /entries/:id`") and found it still holds: nothing in
  this design ever produces a locally-pending/failed write for an entry this unit can display, so no
  reconciliation trigger exists to wire up — confirmed not an oversight, documented as a deliberate, narrow
  scope boundary. This resolves spec.md Clarification 2's own illustrative example ("after the Sessão
  expirada overlay is dismissed and the session is renewed") as a description of `getById()`'s intended
  future purpose, not a call site this unit implements.
- No change surfaces that touches `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, any native iOS project file,
  or any AI provider — Principle III remains intact.

No new violations. Gate remains PASS.

- `now` is an optional override purely for deterministic unit tests ("today" fixed at a known instant); production call sites omit it.

## `EntryMerger` (`lib/features/records/domain/entities/entry_merger.dart`) — NEW

Implements spec.md's resolved Clarification 3 (dedupe-by-ID, preferring the fresher copy).

```dart
class EntryMerger {
  const EntryMerger._();
  static List<Entry> merge({required List<Entry> primary, required List<Entry> secondary}) {
    // union by id, primary's copy wins on a shared id, result sorted newest-to-oldest by occurredAt
  }
}
```

`RecordsBloc` calls `EntryMerger.merge(primary: <freshly fetched or already-displayed entries>, secondary:
entriesRepository.cachedEntries)` every time it has a new batch to show (research.md R3) — never inside
`EntriesRepositoryImpl`.

## `RecordsEvent` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_event.dart`) — NEW

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `RecordsStarted` | `RecordsPage.initState` — triggers the first page fetch. |
| `NextPageRequested` | The list's `ScrollController` crosses a near-bottom threshold, and `!hasReachedEnd && !isLoadingMore`. |
| `PageLoadRetried` | The user taps "Tentar novamente" on a failed first load (`RecordsLoadFailure`) or a failed further-page load (`RecordsLoaded.pageLoadFailure`). |
| `RecordsLocalCacheRefreshed` | `RecordsPage`, once the insertion-modal `showModalBottomSheet` future resolves (research.md R10) — re-merges `cachedEntries` into the currently displayed list, no network call. |

## `RecordsState` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_state.dart`) — NEW

Maps spec.md's "Entry Timeline Page" key entity directly to this sealed state's `RecordsLoaded` fields
(entries fetched so far + the cursor to continue from) — no separate domain class for it (research.md-style
reasonable decision: nothing else needs this shape outside the bloc that owns it).

```dart
sealed class RecordsState {}

class RecordsLoading extends RecordsState {}

class RecordsLoadFailure extends RecordsState {
  const RecordsLoadFailure(this.failure);
  final Failure failure;   // any failure type, including AuthExpiredFailure (research.md — see below)
}

class RecordsLoaded extends RecordsState {
  const RecordsLoaded({
    required this.entries,        // merged + deduped, newest-to-oldest
    required this.nextCursor,
    required this.isLoadingMore,
    this.pageLoadFailure,         // a further-page fetch failed; entries above stay intact, retryable
  });
  final List<Entry> entries;
  final String? nextCursor;
  final bool isLoadingMore;
  final Failure? pageLoadFailure;

  bool get hasReachedEnd => nextCursor == null;
  bool get isEmpty => entries.isEmpty;   // RecordsPage renders "Vazio" for this, never a separate event
}
```

- **First-load failure, any cause (including `AuthExpiredFailure`)** → `RecordsLoadFailure` — never the empty
  state, so a true zero-entries account is never confused with "couldn't load" (research.md's reasoning under
  R5/R7). The one-shot `reauthRequired` stream (next section) still fires in the `AuthExpiredFailure` case, on
  top of this state — the overlay appears over the retryable error screen.
- **Further-page failure, `AuthExpiredFailure`** → `entries`/`nextCursor` are left exactly as they were,
  `isLoadingMore` resets to `false` (so the next scroll-near-bottom re-attempts the same, unconsumed cursor);
  `pageLoadFailure` is **not** set for this case — only the one-shot stream fires. This is what makes FR-007's
  "without discarding the entries already loaded or the current scroll position... restored exactly as it
  was" true by construction (nothing in `RecordsState` changed).
- **Further-page failure, any other cause** (timeout, offline, validation, ...) → `pageLoadFailure` set,
  `isLoadingMore` resets to `false`, entries unchanged — a retryable inline banner at the bottom of the list
  (FR-009/Edge Cases).

## `RecordsBloc` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_bloc.dart`) — NEW

```dart
class RecordsBloc extends Bloc<RecordsEvent, RecordsState> {
  RecordsBloc({required EntriesRepository entriesRepository});

  Stream<void> get reauthRequired;   // one-shot (research.md R5) — fired on a post-retry AuthExpiredFailure
}
```

Depends only on `EntriesRepository` (never `SessionRepository`, never `ConnectivityChecker` — research.md
R4/R11) — the one domain-layer dependency this bloc needs. Never imports `SessionBloc` or any of its
event/state types (requirements.md RF07's own acceptance criterion).

## Widgets (`lib/features/records/presentation/widgets/`, `pages/records_page.dart`) — NEW

Not separately contracted (pure prototype-fidelity rendering, no new state/logic beyond what's above):

- `records_page.dart` — `Scaffold` with the prototype's header (back arrow, title, inert download icon —
  FR-008), inert search bar + funnel button (FR-008), a `ListView` driven by `RecordsLoaded.entries` grouped
  through `DateGrouper`, a `ScrollController` that survives `BlocBuilder` rebuilds (never recreated, so scroll
  position is never lost — FR-003/FR-007), and the `reauthRequired` subscription (research.md R5).
- `record_card.dart` — one entry: spine + icon colored by `source` (table below), monospace time
  (`occurredAt.toLocal()`, `HH:mm`), `SyncBadgeDot` (table above), text excerpt (`content`, no truncation logic
  beyond what the card's fixed layout naturally clips), tag chips (`EntryTag.name`, only when `tags.isNotEmpty`
  — FR-002/Acceptance Scenario 2).
- `records_empty_state.dart` — notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", "Criar primeiro registro" button
  calling the shared `openInsertionModal()` (research.md R10).
- `sync_badge_dot.dart` — the 8px dot + mono label pair, parameterized by `SyncBadgeState`.

**Origin marker mapping** (`prototype-extract.md`'s `sourceMeta`, verbatim hex — reuses existing `DesignTokens`,
no new color token; Phosphor icon names mapped to this app's existing Material-icon convention, same mapping
style RF01/RF02 already used for their own icons):

| `EntrySource` | Spine/icon color | Material icon (Phosphor equivalent) |
|---|---|---|
| `manual` | `DesignTokens.colorPrimary` (`#1F3D34`) | `Icons.edit_outlined` (`ph-pencil-simple`) |
| `audio` | `DesignTokens.colorSecondary` (`#7C8B6F`) | `Icons.mic_none` (`ph-microphone`) |
| `photo` | `DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary` (`#6B6255`) | `Icons.image_outlined` (`ph-image`) |
| `chat` | `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (`#C98A3E`) | `Icons.chat_bubble_outline` (`ph-chat-circle-text`) |

## Routing / DI changes

- `lib/core/routing/app_router.dart`: `AppRoutes.records`'s builder wraps `RecordsPage` in
  `BlocProvider<RecordsBloc>(create: (_) => getIt<RecordsBloc>()..add(const RecordsStarted()))`, replacing the
  direct `RecordsPlaceholderPage()` builder. `records_placeholder_page.dart` is deleted.
- `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`: `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s registration gains `sessionRepository:
  getIt<SessionRepository>()`; one new `getIt.registerFactory<RecordsBloc>(...)`.

# Contract: `EntriesRepository` extension (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)

Extends the interface `specs/003-multimodal-capture/contracts/entries-repository.md` already defines
(`create`, `cachedEntries`, both unchanged) with the two read methods this unit needs. Still the single seam
every feature reading or writing entries depends on — `records/` is simply its first reader.

```dart
abstract class EntriesRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source}); // unchanged
  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;                                                                   // unchanged
  Future<Either<Failure, EntriesPage>> list({String? cursor});
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> getById(String id);
}
```

## `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` (orchestration, data layer)

```dart
Future<Either<Failure, EntriesPage>> list({String? cursor}) async {
  final result = await _remoteDataSource.list(cursor: cursor);
  return result.match(
    (failure) => failure is AuthExpiredFailure
        ? await _retryAfterSilentRefresh(() => _remoteDataSource.list(cursor: cursor))
        : Left(failure),
    (page) => Right(page),
  );
}
```

## `EntriesRepositoryImpl.getById()` (orchestration, data layer)

Identical shape, over `_remoteDataSource.getById(id)` instead.

## The shared retry helper (private to `EntriesRepositoryImpl`)

```dart
Future<Either<Failure, T>> _retryAfterSilentRefresh<T>(
  Future<Either<Failure, T>> Function() retry,
) async {
  final refreshed = await _sessionRepository.refresh();
  return refreshed.match(
    (_) => Left(const AuthExpiredFailure(message: 'Session could not be renewed', requestId: '')),
    (_) => retry(),   // exactly one retry — no loop, no second refresh attempt
  );
}
```

- **Exactly one retry.** If the retried call *also* comes back `AuthExpiredFailure` (a pathological
  double-expiry), it is returned to the caller as-is — no second refresh attempt, no loop. This is a
  deliberately simple, bounded policy; nothing in spec.md requires more.
- **The `Left` branch always normalizes to a fresh `AuthExpiredFailure`**, regardless of what the refresh
  attempt itself failed with (`AuthInvalidFailure` for no stored refresh token, or whatever `/auth/refresh`
  itself returned) — callers (`RecordsBloc`) only ever need to know "could not be silently renewed," not the
  refresh call's own internal failure shape, mirroring how `CheckSessionUseCase` (specs/001) already
  normalizes every unrenewable-session case down to one outcome rather than leaking the refresh call's raw
  failure type upward.
- **`create()` is untouched** — out of this unit's scope (research.md R4).

## `EntriesRemoteDataSource` additions (data layer)

```dart
Future<Either<Failure, EntriesPage>> list({String? cursor}) {
  return _apiClient
      .call('entries-list', method: 'GET', queryParameters: cursor == null ? null : {'cursor': cursor})
      .flatMap(_parseEntriesPage);
}

Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> getById(String id) {
  return _apiClient
      .call('entries-get', method: 'GET', pathSegments: [id])
      .flatMap(_parseEntry);   // the same private parser create() already uses
}
```

- `_parseEntry` (existing, `create()`'s private parser) is reused verbatim for a single object; a new
  `_parseEntriesPage` parses `data` (a list, each element through the same per-entry field logic `_parseEntry`
  already has — factored so neither duplicates the other) and `meta.nextCursor`.
- Malformed-response parsing failures (`TypeError`/`FormatException`) map to `ValidationFailure`, exactly like
  `create()`'s existing `_parseEntry` catch clauses — no new failure-mapping behavior.

## `ApiClient.call()` (core layer) — `queryParameters` addition

```dart
Future<Either<Failure, Map<String, dynamic>>> call(
  String function, {
  required String method,
  Map<String, dynamic>? body,
  List<String>? pathSegments,
  Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters,
  AuthMode authMode = AuthMode.userSession,
}) async {
  // ...unchanged URL-building...
  final response = await _dio.request<Map<String, dynamic>>(
    url,
    data: body,
    queryParameters: queryParameters,   // NEW — passed straight through to dio
    options: Options(method: method, headers: {...}),
  );
  // ...unchanged response handling...
}
```

Every existing call site (`entries-create`, `auth-session`, `auth-refresh`, `media-ocr`) omits the new
parameter and is byte-for-byte unaffected.

## Who depends on this

`RecordsBloc` (`list`/`getById`, via `EntriesRepository` only — never `EntriesRemoteDataSource`/`ApiClient`
directly, same layering every existing feature already observes). No other unit yet calls `list()`/`getById()`
— RF06 (semantic search) is the next likely caller, reusing the same silent-refresh-and-retry behavior for
free.

| # | Scenario | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `list()` succeeds on the first attempt | `Right(EntriesPage(...))`, no refresh call made |
| 2 | `list()` fails `AuthExpiredFailure`, refresh succeeds, retry succeeds | `Right(EntriesPage(...))`, exactly 2 remote calls + 1 refresh call |
| 3 | `list()` fails `AuthExpiredFailure`, refresh itself fails | `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)`, no second refresh attempt |
| 4 | `list()` fails any other code (timeout/offline/validation/...) | `Left(<that failure>)` unchanged, no refresh attempted |
| 5 | `getById()` — same 4 scenarios as `list()` | same shapes |
| 6 | `list(cursor: 'abc')` | `ApiClient.call` receives `queryParameters: {'cursor': 'abc'}` |
| 7 | `list()` (no cursor) | `ApiClient.call` receives `queryParameters: null` |

1	# Research: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)
2	
3	All unknowns below are implementation judgment calls on top of an already-resolved spec (spec.md's four
4	Clarifications) and an already-built F000/RF01 foundation — there is no new external service to evaluate, and
5	only one small, well-known package decision (rejected, R9). Each entry either extends an existing RF01/F000
6	seam to a new, previously-unneeded shape, or fills a gap spec.md leaves to "reasonable technical decision"
7	(Constitution Principle I).
8	
9	## R1 — `ApiClient` gains query-parameter support
10	
11	- **Decision**: `ApiClient.call()` gets one new optional parameter, `Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters`,
12	  passed straight through to `Dio.request()`'s own `queryParameters` argument. Every existing call site is
13	  unaffected (the parameter defaults to omitted/null).
14	- **Rationale**: `GET /entries` (`entries-list`) is this unit's first call whose OpenAPI contract defines
15	  `in: query` parameters (`cursor`, `limit`, plus `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` this unit never sends). Every
16	  endpoint called before this unit (`entries-create`, `auth-session`, `auth-refresh`, `media-ocr`) needed only a
17	  body and/or `pathSegments`, so `ApiClient` never had a reason to carry query parameters. This is a change to
18	  the app's own HTTP wrapper, not to the backend or its contract (Constitution Principle III is about the
19	  backend's contract, not this client-side plumbing).
20	- **Alternatives considered**: Hand-building the query string and appending it to the URL — rejected: `dio`
21	  already does this correctly (encoding, `null`-param omission), and bypassing it would be duplicating
22	  something the dependency already does for free.
23	
24	## R2 — `EntrySource` gains a fourth value, `chat`
25	
26	- **Decision**: `enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }` in `entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` —
27	  the one line RF01's own comment flagged as "`chat` is RF10's own addition" is now wrong in isolation and
28	  gets updated to explain *why* a fourth value exists here even though no capture flow produces it yet.
29	- **Rationale**: spec.md's Edge Cases and Assumptions are explicit: `GET /entries` is origin-agnostic and can
30	  return a `chat`-sourced entry (e.g., from seed/test data) even though RF04/RF10 (the only features that will
31	  ever *create* one) are both later units; this screen "renders the card with the origin's defined marker and
32	  icon like any other, without erroring or treating it as unrecognized." `EntriesRemoteDataSource._parseEntry`
33	  currently calls `EntrySource.values.byName(...)`, which throws `ArgumentError` — not caught by its existing
34	  `on TypeError`/`on FormatException` clauses — for any value outside the enum's current 3. Without this
35	  change, a `chat` entry from the backend would crash parsing instead of rendering, directly contradicting the
36	  Edge Case. No other `Entry` field changes; `serverRevision`/`updatedAt` are already present from RF01 and
37	  are exactly `sync-badge.md`'s two fields.
38	- **Alternatives considered**: Leaving the enum at 3 values and adding a defensive `on ArgumentError` catch
39	  that falls back to some generic/"unknown" rendering — rejected: the OpenAPI contract closes the `source`
40	  enum at exactly 4 values (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`), so there is no fifth value to defend against;
41	  adding a catch-all for a case that cannot occur per the frozen contract would be exactly the kind of
42	  speculative error handling the project's own guidance says to avoid.
43	
44	## R3 — Local-cache ∪ fetched-page merge lives in the `records` feature, not `EntriesRepositoryImpl`
45	
46	- **Decision**: `EntriesRepositoryImpl` gains `list()`/`getById()` as plain fetch methods — neither one reads
47	  nor touches `cachedEntries`. The by-ID dedupe spec.md's Clarification 3 resolves (prefer the freshly-fetched
48	  copy's `updatedAt`/`serverRevision` when the same ID appears in both the local cache and a fetched page) is
49	  implemented once, as a small pure function (`EntryMerger`, data-model.md) inside the new `records/domain/`,
50	  and called by `RecordsBloc` every time it has a new batch of entries to show.
51	- **Rationale**: `cachedEntries`'s own doc comment already says it exists only "so RF07 has something to read
52	  from day one" — reading it is this unit's job, not something `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()`'s *fetch*
53	  responsibility should also carry. Keeping the merge in `records/` keeps `EntriesRepositoryImpl` a simple,
54	  single-purpose data accessor (unchanged shape for `create()`/`cachedEntries`, two new fetch methods) and
55	  keeps the one genuinely screen-specific rule (how a locally-created entry and a later server page reconcile)
56	  local to the one screen that actually needs it.
57	- **Alternatives considered**: Merging inside `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` itself, returning an
58	  already-deduped `EntriesPage` — rejected: `list()` would then need to special-case "is this the first page"
59	  (merging the cache into every subsequent page would re-surface an old locally-created entry on whatever page
60	  its `occurredAt` now falls on, which is fine, but silently entangles a generic fetch method with one
61	  screen's presentation-level display-ordering concern) for no benefit, since `records/` is the only present
62	  or planned caller of `list()`.
63	
64	## R4 — Silent `AUTH_EXPIRED` refresh-and-retry lives inside `EntriesRepositoryImpl`, reusing `SessionRepository.refresh()` directly
65	
66	- **Decision**: `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` and `.getById()` each: call the remote method once; on
67	  `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)`, call the already-injected `SessionRepository.refresh()`; on `Right`, retry the
68	  original remote call exactly once and return *that* result; on `Left` (refresh itself did not succeed),
69	  return `Left(const AuthExpiredFailure(...))` (a fresh instance carrying this call's own `requestId`,
70	  regardless of what specific failure the refresh attempt itself produced). `create()` is untouched — this
71	  unit's scope is its two new read methods, not retrofitting RF01's existing write path.
72	- **Rationale**: This is not a new pattern — `specs/001-foundation/contracts/session-repository.md` already
73	  says, verbatim, "Every later unit that makes an authenticated call and receives `AuthExpiredFailure` calls
74	  `SessionRepository.refresh()` the same way, through this interface — never by re-implementing the refresh
75	  call." RF07 is simply the first unit to actually be that "later unit." Doing it inside `EntriesRepositoryImpl`
76	  (not a `records`-specific use case) means the silent-renewal behavior FR-006 requires is automatically
77	  available to RF06 (semantic search, also `bearerAuth` over `/entries` data) the moment it's built, with zero
78	  duplication. `EntriesRepositoryImpl` gains one new constructor dependency, `SessionRepository` — a
79	  cross-feature *domain*-interface dependency from one feature's data layer into another's, the same shape
80	  `SessionRepositoryImpl` itself already has on `auth`'s `Account` entity, so this introduces no new kind of
81	  coupling, only a new instance of an already-approved one.
82	- **Alternatives considered**: Dispatching an event to the global `SessionBloc` instead and awaiting its
83	  outcome — rejected outright: that would make a `data/`-layer repository depend on a `presentation/`-layer
84	  BLoC, a far more serious layering violation than anything RNF06 is written to catch, and the repository has
85	  no `BuildContext`/widget tree to dispatch through in the first place.
86	
87	## R5 — Routing the "Sessão expirada" overlay trigger through the page, not bloc-to-bloc, via a one-shot stream
88	
89	- **Decision**: `RecordsBloc` exposes `Stream<void> get reauthRequired` — a one-shot side-effect stream,
90	  fired exactly when R4's silent refresh-and-retry has already failed (i.e., whenever `list()`/`getById()`

Clarifications) and an already-built F000/RF01 foundation — there is no new external service to evaluate, and
only one small, well-known package decision (rejected, R9). Each entry either extends an existing RF01/F000
seam to a new, previously-unneeded shape, or fills a gap spec.md leaves to "reasonable technical decision"
(Constitution Principle I).

## R1 — `ApiClient` gains query-parameter support

- **Decision**: `ApiClient.call()` gets one new optional parameter, `Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters`,
  passed straight through to `Dio.request()`'s own `queryParameters` argument. Every existing call site is
  unaffected (the parameter defaults to omitted/null).
- **Rationale**: `GET /entries` (`entries-list`) is this unit's first call whose OpenAPI contract defines
  `in: query` parameters (`cursor`, `limit`, plus `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` this unit never sends). Every
  endpoint called before this unit (`entries-create`, `auth-session`, `auth-refresh`, `media-ocr`) needed only a
  body and/or `pathSegments`, so `ApiClient` never had a reason to carry query parameters. This is a change to
  the app's own HTTP wrapper, not to the backend or its contract (Constitution Principle III is about the
  backend's contract, not this client-side plumbing).
- **Alternatives considered**: Hand-building the query string and appending it to the URL — rejected: `dio`
  already does this correctly (encoding, `null`-param omission), and bypassing it would be duplicating
  something the dependency already does for free.

## R2 — `EntrySource` gains a fourth value, `chat`

- **Decision**: `enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }` in `entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` —
  the one line RF01's own comment flagged as "`chat` is RF10's own addition" is now wrong in isolation and
  gets updated to explain *why* a fourth value exists here even though no capture flow produces it yet.
- **Rationale**: spec.md's Edge Cases and Assumptions are explicit: `GET /entries` is origin-agnostic and can
  return a `chat`-sourced entry (e.g., from seed/test data) even though RF04/RF10 (the only features that will
  ever *create* one) are both later units; this screen "renders the card with the origin's defined marker and
  icon like any other, without erroring or treating it as unrecognized." `EntriesRemoteDataSource._parseEntry`
  currently calls `EntrySource.values.byName(...)`, which throws `ArgumentError` — not caught by its existing
  `on TypeError`/`on FormatException` clauses — for any value outside the enum's current 3. Without this
  change, a `chat` entry from the backend would crash parsing instead of rendering, directly contradicting the
  Edge Case. No other `Entry` field changes; `serverRevision`/`updatedAt` are already present from RF01 and
  are exactly `sync-badge.md`'s two fields.
- **Alternatives considered**: Leaving the enum at 3 values and adding a defensive `on ArgumentError` catch
  that falls back to some generic/"unknown" rendering — rejected: the OpenAPI contract closes the `source`
  enum at exactly 4 values (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`), so there is no fifth value to defend against;
  adding a catch-all for a case that cannot occur per the frozen contract would be exactly the kind of
  speculative error handling the project's own guidance says to avoid.

  nor touches `cachedEntries`. The by-ID dedupe spec.md's Clarification 3 resolves (prefer the freshly-fetched

  implemented once, as a small pure function (`EntryMerger`, data-model.md) inside the new `records/domain/`,
  and called by `RecordsBloc` every time it has a new batch of entries to show.

  from day one" — reading it is this unit's job, not something `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()`'s *fetch*

  local to the one screen that actually needs it.

  already-deduped `EntriesPage` — rejected: `list()` would then need to special-case "is this the first page"
  (merging the cache into every subsequent page would re-surface an old locally-created entry on whatever page
  its `occurredAt` now falls on, which is fine, but silently entangles a generic fetch method with one
  screen's presentation-level display-ordering concern) for no benefit, since `records/` is the only present
  or planned caller of `list()`.

  coupling, only a new instance of an already-approved one.

- **Alternatives considered**: Renaming `records/` to `timeline/` for closer alignment with this spec's own
  folder name — rejected: it would touch the route constant, the drawer, and every existing reference to
  `RecordsPlaceholderPage` for a purely cosmetic rename with no architectural benefit.

## R9 — Date-group labels are a small hand-written lookup, not a new `intl` dependency

- **Decision**: `DateGrouper` (data-model.md) computes "Hoje"/"Ontem"/an explicit date itself, comparing each
  entry's `occurredAt.toLocal()` calendar day against `DateTime.now().toLocal()`'s. The explicit-date case is
  formatted as `'{day} de {monthName}'` (e.g., "14 de outubro") from a 12-entry `const` Portuguese month-name
  list local to this file — no year shown, matching the prototype's own plain "dates" wording with no sample
  format shown. `pubspec.yaml` gains no new dependency.
- **Rationale**: This app has never needed locale-aware date formatting before (every existing timestamp —
  the audio recorder's `00:12`, `expected-transcription.md`'s fixtures — is either monospace-counter or raw)
  and needs only 12 fixed Portuguese month names here, a one-time, never-changing lookup table far smaller
  than what pulling in `intl` (locale data, `DateFormat`, ICU plural rules) would justify for a single call
  site.
- **Alternatives considered**: Adding `intl` — rejected per the above; a `dd/MM/yyyy` numeric format instead
  of a written-out month name — rejected as a visual-fidelity concern: `prototype-extract.md`'s "Ontem" /
  "Hoje" labels read as prose, not as a numeric field, so an explicit older date is written the same way for
  consistency within the same date-heading row.

## R10 — Extracting `openInsertionModal()` once, shared by Home/Chat and "Meus Registros"'s empty state

- **Decision**: The existing private `_openInsertionModal()` in `home_chat_shell_page.dart` is promoted to a
  single public function in `capture/presentation/widgets/open_insertion_modal.dart` — identical body (the
  same `showModalBottomSheet`/`BlocProvider<InsertionModalBloc>`/`InsertionModalPage` it already is), called
  from both `home_chat_shell_page.dart`'s "+" button and `records_page.dart`'s empty-state "Criar primeiro
  registro" CTA (spec.md FR-004, Clarification 1). `RecordsPage` awaits the `Future` `showModalBottomSheet`
  returns and, once it resolves (the sheet popped itself on a successful save — unchanged RF01/RF02 behavior,
  `insertion_modal_page.dart`'s `closeRequests` listener), dispatches a `RecordsLocalCacheRefreshed` event so
  the newly created entry (already appended to `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` by the time the sheet closes)
  is merged into view (R3) without any network call.
- **Rationale**: Clarification 1 already settles *where* a save from here returns to — "this screen, not
  Home/Chat" — and the mechanism for that is simply "don't navigate away to open it": `showModalBottomSheet`
  always pops back onto whichever screen presented it, so calling the exact same opening function from
  `RecordsPage` already produces the required return-to-this-screen behavior with zero new routing. Once there
  are 2 call sites for an identical 4-line function, extracting it is the same bar RF02's research.md R7 used
  for consolidating two near-duplicate usecases — not a premature abstraction, since both call sites really are
  identical.
- **Alternatives considered**: Duplicating the 4-line `showModalBottomSheet` call in `records_page.dart`
  instead — rejected once there are genuinely two identical call sites; three similar-but-different lines
  would be fine, but these would be the same lines twice.

## R11 — No pre-emptive connectivity gate before fetching a page

- **Decision**: Neither `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` nor `RecordsBloc`'s page-fetch handling calls
  `ConnectivityChecker` before attempting the network call. Offline is detected the same way it already is for
  every other call through `ApiClient`: a `DioException` with no response at all is already synthesized into
  `NetworkOfflineFailure` by `ApiClient._mapException` (existing code, unchanged).
- **Rationale**: RF01/RF02's pre-write connectivity checks (`SaveTextEntryUseCase`, `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`)
  exist specifically to avoid burning an expensive *local* operation (on-device transcription, OCR) ahead of a
  write that would fail anyway — there is no equivalent local cost to protect before a plain `GET`. Attempting
  the call and letting the existing offline-failure path handle it is simpler and reuses infrastructure that
  already satisfies FR-009 ("fails with a clear, retryable message rather than hanging or crashing") with zero
  new code.
- **Alternatives considered**: Adding the same `ConnectivityChecker` pre-check "for consistency with
  capture" — rejected: it would add a dependency and a code path that exists purely to skip a call that costs
  nothing to attempt and already fails cleanly on its own.

1	# Quickstart: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)
2	
3	How to validate this unit end-to-end once implemented, mapped to spec.md's four user stories. A run guide —
4	interfaces are in `contracts/`, state/entities in `data-model.md`.
5	
6	## Prerequisites
7	
8	- F000, RF01, RF03 already implemented and passing (this unit depends on all three per spec.md's header).
9	  `EntriesRepository`/`Entry`/`CreateEntryUseCase` (RF01) and `SessionRepository`/`SessionBloc`/the "Sessão
10	  expirada" overlay (F000) are extended, not replaced.
11	- A signed-in test account with entries spanning at least 3 different calendar days, created across at least
12	  `manual`, `audio`, and `photo` origins (reuse RF01/RF02's own fixtures to create them), and — since no
13	  capture flow can produce one — a `chat`-sourced entry seeded directly in the backend/fixtures to exercise
14	  Edge Cases' "renders a `chat` entry without erroring" scenario.
15	- A second, brand-new test account with zero entries, for Story 2.
16	- Enough entries (more than one backend page — the default page size is 20) to exercise pagination for
17	  Story 1's Acceptance Scenario 3.
18	
19	## Automated checks
20	
21	```bash
22	fvm flutter analyze                                    # RNF06 import-shape lint
23	fvm flutter test --coverage
24	lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info
25	genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain-html    # RNF07 gate — now covering entry_merger.dart,
26	                                                         # date_group.dart, sync_badge_state.dart, plus
27	                                                         # EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()/getById()
28	dart test/architecture/no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart   # requirements.md RF07's own acceptance criterion
29	```
30	
31	`contracts/entries-repository-extension.md` and `contracts/records-bloc.md` each carry the full scenario
32	table this unit's coverage depends on.
33	
34	## Manual verification (device/Simulator)
35	
36	### Story 1 — Seeing every entry in one place, regardless of origin (P1)
37	
38	1. Open the side menu (☰) → "Meus Registros" from Home/Chat. **Expect**: records grouped under "Hoje" /
39	   "Ontem" / explicit older dates (newest group first), each card showing the right spine color + icon for
40	   its origin (manual = dark green/pencil, audio = olive green/mic, photo = gray/image, chat =
41	   ochre/chat-bubble), a time, a sync badge, a text excerpt, and tag chips only on entries that actually have
42	   tags.
43	2. Confirm the seeded `chat`-origin entry renders like any other card (ochre spine, chat-bubble icon) — no
44	   crash, no "unrecognized" placeholder.
45	3. Scroll to the bottom. **Expect**: further entries load and append automatically, with no "load more"
46	   button, no disturbance to the cards already on screen, and no visible scroll jump.
47	4. Scroll to the true end of history. **Expect**: loading simply stops — no error banner, no "end of list"
48	   message.
49	
50	### Story 2 — Starting from nothing (P1)
51	
52	1. Sign in on the zero-entries account, open "Meus Registros". **Expect**: the notebook icon, "Nenhum
53	   registro ainda", and the "Criar primeiro registro" button — never a blank or perpetually-loading screen.
54	2. Tap "Criar primeiro registro". **Expect**: the same Insertion Modal RF01/RF02 already built opens over
55	   this screen.
56	3. Save a text entry. **Expect**: the modal closes back onto "Meus Registros" (not Home/Chat), and the new
57	   entry now appears in its correct date group ("Hoje"), replacing the empty state.
58	
59	### Story 3 — The session expires while browsing (P2)
60	
61	1. Load "Meus Registros" with several entries visible, scroll to a specific, identifiable position.
62	2. Force the next `GET /entries` call to return `AUTH_EXPIRED` (e.g., via a debug toggle/expired test token)
63	   and either scroll further or wait for a background refresh attempt to trigger it. **Expect**: the "Sessão
64	   expirada" overlay appears over the screen; the entries and scroll position underneath are completely
65	   unchanged (confirm by dismissing-and-checking before re-authenticating, if your test harness allows it).
66	3. Tap "Entrar novamente" and re-authenticate successfully. **Expect**: the overlay dismisses; the screen is
67	   exactly as it was (same entries, same scroll position) — no reload, no reordering.
68	4. Scroll further again. **Expect**: pagination now resumes normally (the next page is fetched successfully
69	   with the fresh session).
70	
71	### Story 4 — The sync badge tells the truth, even during session trouble (P3)
72	
73	1. With entries visible, force a silent session renewal in the background (a renewable `AUTH_EXPIRED` the
74	   refresh call recovers from transparently). **Expect**: no visible change to any card — no badge flicker,
75	   no overlay, no reload (silent renewal never surfaces to the UI).
76	2. Repeat Story 3's forced-expiry-and-overlay flow. **Expect**: once the overlay is dismissed, every badge on
77	   every card underneath shows exactly the same state (color + label) it showed before the overlay appeared.
78	3. Since every entry this unit can display is already server-confirmed by construction (research.md R6),
79	   every badge observed in steps 1–2 should read "sincronizado" (green) — this is expected, not a bug; it is
80	   not possible to observe "sincronizando"/"erro de sync" through this unit's own flows alone (spec.md

# Quickstart: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)

How to validate this unit end-to-end once implemented, mapped to spec.md's four user stories. A run guide —
interfaces are in `contracts/`, state/entities in `data-model.md`.

## Prerequisites

- F000, RF01, RF03 already implemented and passing (this unit depends on all three per spec.md's header).
  `EntriesRepository`/`Entry`/`CreateEntryUseCase` (RF01) and `SessionRepository`/`SessionBloc`/the "Sessão
  expirada" overlay (F000) are extended, not replaced.
- A signed-in test account with entries spanning at least 3 different calendar days, created across at least
  `manual`, `audio`, and `photo` origins (reuse RF01/RF02's own fixtures to create them), and — since no
  capture flow can produce one — a `chat`-sourced entry seeded directly in the backend/fixtures to exercise
  Edge Cases' "renders a `chat` entry without erroring" scenario.
- A second, brand-new test account with zero entries, for Story 2.
- Enough entries (more than one backend page — the default page size is 20) to exercise pagination for
  Story 1's Acceptance Scenario 3.

## Automated checks

```bash
fvm flutter analyze                                    # RNF06 import-shape lint
fvm flutter test --coverage
lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info
genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain-html    # RNF07 gate — now covering entry_merger.dart,
                                                         # date_group.dart, sync_badge_state.dart, plus
                                                         # EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()/getById()
dart test/architecture/no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart   # requirements.md RF07's own acceptance criterion
```

`contracts/entries-repository-extension.md` and `contracts/records-bloc.md` each carry the full scenario
table this unit's coverage depends on.

## Manual verification (device/Simulator)

### Story 1 — Seeing every entry in one place, regardless of origin (P1)

1. Open the side menu (☰) → "Meus Registros" from Home/Chat. **Expect**: records grouped under "Hoje" /
   "Ontem" / explicit older dates (newest group first), each card showing the right spine color + icon for
   its origin (manual = dark green/pencil, audio = olive green/mic, photo = gray/image, chat =
   ochre/chat-bubble), a time, a sync badge, a text excerpt, and tag chips only on entries that actually have
   tags.
2. Confirm the seeded `chat`-origin entry renders like any other card (ochre spine, chat-bubble icon) — no
   crash, no "unrecognized" placeholder.
3. Scroll to the bottom. **Expect**: further entries load and append automatically, with no "load more"
   button, no disturbance to the cards already on screen, and no visible scroll jump.
4. Scroll to the true end of history. **Expect**: loading simply stops — no error banner, no "end of list"
   message.

### Story 2 — Starting from nothing (P1)

1. Sign in on the zero-entries account, open "Meus Registros". **Expect**: the notebook icon, "Nenhum
   registro ainda", and the "Criar primeiro registro" button — never a blank or perpetually-loading screen.
2. Tap "Criar primeiro registro". **Expect**: the same Insertion Modal RF01/RF02 already built opens over
   this screen.
3. Save a text entry. **Expect**: the modal closes back onto "Meus Registros" (not Home/Chat), and the new
   entry now appears in its correct date group ("Hoje"), replacing the empty state.

### Story 3 — The session expires while browsing (P2)

1. Load "Meus Registros" with several entries visible, scroll to a specific, identifiable position.
2. Force the next `GET /entries` call to return `AUTH_EXPIRED` (e.g., via a debug toggle/expired test token)
   and either scroll further or wait for a background refresh attempt to trigger it. **Expect**: the "Sessão
   expirada" overlay appears over the screen; the entries and scroll position underneath are completely
   unchanged (confirm by dismissing-and-checking before re-authenticating, if your test harness allows it).
3. Tap "Entrar novamente" and re-authenticate successfully. **Expect**: the overlay dismisses; the screen is
   exactly as it was (same entries, same scroll position) — no reload, no reordering.
4. Scroll further again. **Expect**: pagination now resumes normally (the next page is fetched successfully
   with the fresh session).

### Story 4 — The sync badge tells the truth, even during session trouble (P3)

1. With entries visible, force a silent session renewal in the background (a renewable `AUTH_EXPIRED` the
   refresh call recovers from transparently). **Expect**: no visible change to any card — no badge flicker,
   no overlay, no reload (silent renewal never surfaces to the UI).
2. Repeat Story 3's forced-expiry-and-overlay flow. **Expect**: once the overlay is dismissed, every badge on
   every card underneath shows exactly the same state (color + label) it showed before the overlay appeared.
3. Since every entry this unit can display is already server-confirmed by construction (research.md R6),
   every badge observed in steps 1–2 should read "sincronizado" (green) — this is expected, not a bug; it is
   not possible to observe "sincronizando"/"erro de sync" through this unit's own flows alone (spec.md
   Assumptions).

### Edge cases worth exercising manually at least once

- Turn on airplane mode after the first page has loaded, then scroll to trigger another page. **Expect**: a
  clear, retryable inline error at the bottom of the list; the entries already shown stay visible and
  scrollable; no write of any kind is attempted.
- Turn airplane mode back on, tap the retry affordance from that error. **Expect**: it fails again cleanly
  (no crash); turn airplane mode off and retry again. **Expect**: pagination resumes normally.
- Force the very first `GET /entries` call (on screen open) to fail outright (not just offline). **Expect**:
  a full-screen retryable error — never the "Nenhum registro ainda" empty state.
- Tap the header's download icon and the search bar/funnel button. **Expect**: both render exactly per the
  prototype but do nothing (FR-008 — inert placeholders; no export, no filter sheet, no search).
- With a known seeded account (more than one page of entries where the newest page happens to be empty, e.g.
  nothing created "today" or "yesterday" but older entries exist), open "Meus Registros". **Expect**: paging
  continues directly to the older groups — the empty state must **not** appear.

- **US4**: verified badge-state independence from session trouble (already true by construction).
- **Polish**: `flutter analyze` clean, domain-purity and no-bloc-imports architecture tests pass, domain coverage 92.3% (≥80% gate).

**One necessary deviation from the design docs**, flagged for your awareness: the contracts assumed `ApiClient.call()` would hand back `meta.nextCursor` for pagination, but the existing client only ever returned the already-unwrapped `data` field and silently discarded `meta` — and `entries-list`'s `data` is an array, which the old code would've always rejected as a validation failure. I added an opt-in `unwrapData` parameter (default `true`, preserving every existing call site byte-for-byte, confirmed by the existing locked-in tests) that `entries-list` alone sets to `false` to get the full envelope. Covered by new tests in `api_client_test.dart` and `entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`.
